note: KOA Holiday just off I-65 at Horse Cave, about 20-25 minutes from Mammoth Cave National Park, with cabins, wagons, teepees and treehouses alongside the RV sites. Campers mention audible highway noise and some hard-to-level full-hookup sites (reviews, autumn 2026). Pool (Memorial Day to Labor Day weekend), mini golf, jumping pillow, free fishing, dog park. --Claude
